source: his 2026-10-26 10:27: "Missonboard. Spacers have stockpiled illegal drugs in cargo containers near a space outpost. Destroy the containers." then "Has a Spacer base (unboardable, just a decoration), spacer ships guarding and a few container activators to blow up"
_note: THE SPACE BOARD FAMILY, 5: THE STOCKPILE. A crew is sitting on a stockpile of contraband in cargo containers beside
their base in orbit. Blow up the containers. The verb is DESTROY: his MB14 and MB15 ('Strike' in board-names.md),
which are the prior art in his own catalogue, and MB15 (destroy a station) may be the nearer base. Eliza's call.
THREE THINGS BOARDSPACE DOES NOT BUILD TODAY (it is MB01a whole: one use on one activator), and the lint refuses each:
(1) THREE CONTAINERS: three uses behind one counter (group), 'any order', objective (0/3). His MB01 activator is one.
(2) THE BASE: a static in the space cell, not boardable, never an objective. No field exists; 'dressing' is a stand-in.
(3) THE GUARDS: hostile ships in the cell from arrival. No field exists; 'ships' is a stand-in. The ground's waves
are the shape (list, min, max), the space shell's own target was a ship, and his MB15 has a combat flag.
WORDS: 'Spacers' and the drug's name are faction and item words, so nothing voiced says either. The card says
'contraband' and 'an armed crew'. 'Their base' and 'their ships' are only said because both are placed.
The broadcast plays at 1500 m (the template's). Closing line on the radio, on the last container. Pay: med, capped.

beats.journal: The first container went up like it was full of something that wanted to burn. Two more.
Another container gone. The crew's ships know exactly what I'm doing now.
beats.name: Contraband Container

broadcast: You're close enough to see them now. Those containers are what we're paying you for.
Their ships will be on you the moment you start.
Don't stop to argue with them. Just make sure none of it's left.
_speech: Station Security: whoever posted the job, not the crew. Clara (Direct, Firm and Confident), already in five recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
recap: An armed crew had a stockpile of contraband in cargo containers beside their base over <Planet>. I blew up every container. Whatever was in them won't be sold now.
recapSay: Whatever was in there, nobody's selling it now.
_recap: The grouped ending, as 23a: stage 100 carries the recap and the closing radio. boardspace refuses a recapSay today (one beat, so the closing line was its say); with a group it wants this. Reward placement follows 23a.
_reward: med, capped. 23a's grouped ending carries no reward tier, so where it goes on a grouped board ending is Eliza's.
